text: kho āvuso bhojane mattaññū hoti . [186] kathañcāvuso jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti . idhāvuso bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pādena 1 pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti . evaṃ kho āvuso jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti . tasmātihāvuso evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ indriyesu guttadvārā
